ask.where: /markdrop ask How do I connect Postgres?

text.text: Create a read-only user in Postgres, then add it under Settings › Data sources › Postgres with the host, port and database [1]. Connections from Acme come from two fixed IP addresses you can allow in your firewall [2].

*Sources*
[1] <https://docs.acme.com/guides/setup/connect-postgres|Connect Postgres>
[2] <https://docs.acme.com/security-faq|Security FAQ>

text.text:
*Markdrop in Slack* (only you see these replies)
• `/markdrop search <words>` finds documents, pages, files and folders you can open
• `/markdrop ask <question>` asks your workspace (Ask <Workspace>): answers from what you can open, with sources
• `/markdrop meetings <question>` answers from your workspace's meetings
• `/markdrop link` links your Slack account to your Markdrop account (once)
• `/markdrop unlink` removes that link
Direct messages for mentions, sign-off requests, shares and access requests are off until you turn them on in Markdrop: Settings › Account › Slack notifications.
